name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-commerce-product-requests
description: Sold-out size requests and the admin inbox. Enable to allow both; disable to hide both. No Configure form — plugin enable is the switch.

commentMax.label: Comment max length
commentMax.description: Maximum characters on a size / make-request comment.
commentMax.sectionDescription: Who receives a make-request and how often a customer may send one.

smtpUser.label: Reply SMTP user
smtpUser.description: SMTP user used when the shop replies to a request. Leave empty to use kernel no-reply.

recipient.label: Request recipient
recipient.description: Mailbox that receives new product requests. Required for staff to see them by mail.

disableRate.label: Disable request rate limit
disableRate.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.
